title: Juicy Nostalgic Ukrainian Cabbage Dumplings
description: Rich and juicy Ukrainian dish featuring elderflower and ferment-kimchi, made vegan-friendly, this recipe brings back nostalgic memories of traditional Eastern European cuisine. It is a hearty and flavorful meal that combines the best of Ukrainian ingredients and cooking techniques.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine chopped cabbage, elderflower syrup, vegan kimchi, crumbled tofu, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, vegan egg replacement, water, salt, and black pepper to form a dough.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a thick batter forms.
Using your hands, shape the batter into small dumplings.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
Garnish with additional elderflower syrup and vegan kimchi, if desired.
